CSE-3274                                                                                                                     about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 12-Jun-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  Pattern Recognition [CSE-3274]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare and contrast DBSCAN with k-means in terms of:  
  Shape of clusters and Sensitivity to noise. Explain with a suitable example.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyse the concepts of weight initialization and learning rate in the training of a  
  backpropagation neural network. Show how weights are updated in backpropagation and (5)  
  what is the purpose of It?  
  
  2)           Apply the Expectation-Maximization algorithm to estimate the parameters of a Gaussian  
  Mixture Model.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyse the role of learning rate and activation function in the training process of a Back  
  Propagation Neural Network.                                                                 (5)  
  
  3)           Summarize probabilistic separability-based criterion functions. How do they help in  
  selecting discriminative features?  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply the concept of data abstraction in pattern recognition by describing a real-world  
  example where it helps simplify complex data.                                                 (2)  
  
  C)      Determine the DBSCAN algorithm and apply clustering with the following parameters:  
  A(1, 2), B(2, 2), C(2, 3), D(8, 7), E(8, 8), F(25, 80), G(24, 79), H(26, 81), I(2, 1), J(1, 1)  
  $$Parameter: Epsilon (ε) = 2, MinPts = 3                                                         (5)$$  
  i. Identify the core points, border points, and noise points.  
  ii. Form the clusters based on the parameters. List of which points belong to each cluster.  
  
  4)           Model a real-world problem using an HMM. Discuss the states, observations, and  
  probability matrices.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare the concept of Gini and Entropy to determine the best attribute to split the root  
  node of the following dataset. Show your calculations clearly.                            (5)
